source: Meta/WRI global canopy height model v2 (forests/v2/global/dinov3_global_chm_v2_ml3), CC BY 4.0, tile 1202021101
method: Kolkata fetch-canopy.py _generate: 10 m cells, 0..4 instances per cell scaling with height against a fixed 30 m reference, deterministic jitter. Tree COUNT is a display scaling, not a measurement; canopy HEIGHT is measured. Species drawn as Kolkata's: hash01(col, row, kk, 3) over its SPECIES tuple. Trees inside a drawn carriageway or a building footprint are dropped.
